rationale: Single-device, single-process TTFT task (no communication, so nccl_tuning, collective_calibration and device_telemetry's communication use are inapplicable; observations.json records communication as not_applicable 'single-device task'). The evaluated candidate 2cb762292afdd4b617dd5c4935afbd3e995ce6d3085a61d9156fb70b0d5b13f5 passes quality but was not accepted (paired_gain_not_above_noise: 24.44 ms vs 26.91 ms paired parent, original reference 24.61 ms), and its coverage shows 62/64 invocations on candidate-declared 'parent-passthrough' with only 2 on 'parent-eager'; the endpoint states these route labels are candidate-reported telemetry requiring corroboration by traces or actual exception evidence. Plan: (1) candidate_diagnostics on this exact candidate to capture handled exceptions (with library traceback locations) and False returns that would reveal silent fallback behind the declared passthrough routing - noting empty events cannot confirm which successful path ran. (2) execution_timeline for a separate plain Torch trace on this candidate with CPU-to-CUDA submit associations, synchronization events and per-device intervals, to corroborate the actually executed kernel sequence around the explicit first-token-ready boundary and attribute TTFT to host dispatch gaps vs device execution. (3) nsys (available per request.json tools) as an independent GPU-side timeline to resolve host/GPU overlap and attribution questions execution_timeline cannot close (its clock alignment bounds cover CPU submissions only; GPU readiness may remain unknown). (4) binding_cost, applicable because the candidate is additive (retains the parent's empty bundle set and adds trial-1a25041f29-param-4c76f383; effective 'direct' binding under 'no functional replacements' is explicitly eligible), to quantify whole-invocation binding overhead of the binding-only passthrough - with 62/64 invocations routing through passthrough, binding overhead may dominate the candidate's net effect and explain the not-above-noise result; it also runs in subsequent candidate resource feedback. python_runtime is excluded because cProfile perturbs execution and its inclusive/self times are not clean scores, and the host-overhead question is answered more cleanly by binding_cost plus execution_timeline/nsys. torch already ran on the parent discovery run (coverage.json: 66441/66441 kernels associated, 0 ambiguous), so a candidate-side trace is supplied by execution_timeline/nsys instead. Revision is set to the single listed candidate whose uncertainty motivates collection.
